responsibility: Implements application of recorded jump-threading opportunities to the CFG and SSA form. It stores thread paths, groups incoming edges by threaded destinations, duplicates or templates blocks as needed, rewires edges through copied/joiner blocks, recreates or redirects PHI arguments and SSA defs, estimates statements killed by threading, handles loop-header threading/peeling cases, and marks loops and SSA for repair after the registered paths have been materialized.
same_name_distinction: This .c file applies recorded jump-thread opportunities by duplicating or templating blocks, rewiring CFG edges, repairing PHIs/SSA form, and handling loop-header threading cases. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-threadupdate.h, it is not the registry/type declaration layer that describes jump_thread_edge records, path allocators, and validation helpers.
